content_sections.heading: DIBD DIC Recruitment 2026 - Salary
content_sections.text: The selected candidates will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 50,000/- Per Month.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the DIBD DIC Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 05-09-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of DIBD DIC to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the DIBD DIC Young Professional recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form for the DIBD DIC Young Professional posts is 05 September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Young Professional posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 8 vacancies announced for the Young Professional positions in the Digital India BHASHINI Division.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Young Professional posts?
faq.answer: The educational qualifications vary by specialization, including degrees in Technology, Law (LLB), and general graduation with an MBA.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Young Professional posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all Young Professional posts is 32 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Young Professional positions?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 50,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for DIBD DIC recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for these posts?
faq.answer: The application process for the DIBD DIC Young Professional recruitment is entirely online.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Young Professional roles?
faq.answer: The selection process primarily involves shortlisting of eligible candidates.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section of this article, which will contain detailed information.

faq.question: Q10. Which city is the job location for these positions?
faq.answer: The job location for these positions is Noida, Delhi.
